news.title: Authorities arrest arson suspect in connection with one of the devastating Spokane wildfires
news.description: Authorities say they’ve arrested a 37-year-old man suspected of starting one of the devastating wildfires burning around Spokane, Washington. The Spokane County Sheriff’s Office said Monday they arrested Aaron F. Farinacci for arson. He’s accused of starting the Old Trails Fire. Several fires are burning in the area. They’ve destroyed at least 700 structures and forced more than 60,000 people to evacuate. The fire sparked on Saturday.

Full annual totals remain pending year-end compilation, but these indicators suggest mysteries and genre hybrids as key drivers for 2025 fiction sales.[39][37][40] Throughout the 2020s, a select group of authors has consistently dominated the Publishers Weekly bestseller lists, driven by strong sales in romance, historical fiction, and fantasy genres.
